# Car Repair Wala

> Car Repair Wala is an independent multi-brand car garage in Indore, Madhya Pradesh (India) for car servicing, AC repair, brakes and clutch, battery and electrical work, diagnostics, denting and painting, detailing and car wash. Estimates are shown before booking, extra work is done only with the customer's approval, and pickup and drop is free in confirmed Indore PIN codes.

- Owner: Amit Singh
- Address: 17, AB Rd, Choithram Mandi, Indore, Madhya Pradesh 452012
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 89659 57978
- Opening hours: Every day (Monday–Sunday): 7:00 AM–11:30 PM (IST)
- Areas served: Indore, Vijay Nagar, Rajendra Nagar, Sudama Nagar, Khajrana, Tilak Nagar, Bijasan Road
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=853408414821901526
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/car_repairwala_indore/
- Not affiliated with any car manufacturer; brand names identify the cars we work on.

## Common questions

- **Is the price shown by the calculator final?** No. The calculator gives an estimated range. Your final quotation is shared after a mechanic inspects the car, and no extra work is done without your approval.
- **Do you repair all car brands?** We are a multi-brand garage. Tell us your car's make, model and year on WhatsApp and we will confirm before you book.
- **Is pickup and drop really free?** Pickup and drop is free within our confirmed Indore service area, subject to booking confirmation. Enter your PIN code on the Pickup & Drop page to check your area.
- **Can I choose genuine (OEM) parts?** Yes. The estimator lets you compare economy, standard and genuine parts. The parts used are written on your itemised bill.
- **What if the mechanic finds another problem?** We call or WhatsApp you with the issue and the extra cost first. Work starts only after you approve it.
- **How do I pay?** Payment terms are shared with your final quotation. You receive an itemised bill listing labour and parts separately.
